headline: Review the recipient before first contact
subtext: Search the public Directory, read what Verified means, then open View Profile to decide whether the recipient fits your tip.
image_alt_text: A Hush Line social graphic titled “Review the recipient before first contact.” It shows the public Directory in light mode: a Tor Browser reminder, a Directory description, recipient tabs with Verified selected, a Search verified users field, a note explaining that Verified account owners confirmed their identities with Hush Line staff, and a recipient card with a View Profile link.

social.bluesky:
Before writing a tip, decide who should receive it.

Use Hush Line’s public Directory to search Verified listings or recipient categories, then open View Profile and read the recipient’s details. If the profile fits, you can make first contact without an account.

https://tips.hushline.app/directory
social.linkedin:
The first step is not writing the tip. It is deciding who should receive it.

In Hush Line’s public Directory, a visitor can start with Verified listings or a recipient category, search by name, and read what the Verified label means. From there, View Profile opens the recipient’s public details so the visitor can decide whether that person fits the message.

If the profile is the right match, the visitor can continue to first contact without creating an account or downloading an app.

Start with the Directory. Open the profile before you write the message: https://tips.hushline.app/directory

rationale: The Directory screenshot is the only eligible candidate after cooldown exhaustion and directly supports the public-source intent. The workflow angle is distinct from the recent role-based Directory post: it puts the recipient decision before drafting, explains the order of the visible controls, and ends with the no-account path to first contact. The hook and CTA are specific to this workflow, and the copy does not treat verification as a substitute for reading the profile.
